This page documents narrow loot-selection observations, not a complete or runtime-verified drop guide.

'''Weights are not probabilities.''' Selection order, eligibility, repeated draws, empty outcomes, and shared conditions can affect the result. The wiki does not normalize reported weights or turn them into percentages.

A conditional probability appears only when separately supported by the cited evidence. Unknown quantities, roll counts, and probabilities remain unknown. An explicit empty result is different from an unidentified item.
